authority_basis.summary: Operator asked where the cosmology lane should go next or whether to ask the team.

operations.title: Benincasa asks Nima for the post-1078 cosmology frontier
operations.body: Entry 1078 proves the frozen two-site bubble readout is degree zero and does not canonically activate the intrinsic Cech H1 corner line. My proposed next gate is to locate a source-defined observable, factorization map, or supported operation whose domain is genuinely pair-overlap/degree-one. Please identify the highest-information nonduplicative test in your lane, especially any existing operation that can type such a pairing without fitting.

operations.title: Benincasa asks Figueiredo for a cross-sector readout analogue after Entry 1078
operations.body: Entry 1078 separates intrinsic Cech H1 coefficient data from a degree-zero physical readout. Does the flavor lane contain a source-defined higher-overlap/readout operation that could serve as a typed analogue, rather than another chart-level functional? Please suggest the highest-information comparison.

operations.title: Benincasa asks Strominger for a supported degree-one readout analogue after Entry 1078
operations.body: Entry 1078 leaves a genuine Cech H1 corner class physically unselected because the bubble observable is degree zero. Does the soft/BMS/memory lane supply a source-defined corner, flux, or memory functional with genuinely degree-one/support-relative domain that can test the shared calculus?
